name: Gloating
overview: Scripture warns against gloating over the misfortune of others, teaching believers to refrain from rejoicing when enemies fall or stumble, as seen in Proverbs 24:17 and Obadiah 1:12-13. Such prideful attitudes, including boasting and magnifying one's own mouth, are cautioned against, with Proverbs 27:2 encouraging humility by letting others praise us rather than ourselves. Additionally, Habakkuk 2:4 contrasts a soul lifted up in pride with the just who live by faith, underscoring that true righteousness is marked by faithfulness rather than self-exaltation or delight in others’ calamity.
